disambiguation: Not a device synchronization tool; it imports local browser history into Markdown files.
extras: Desktop-only plugin requiring local browser history access.
intentEvidence: Obsidian Browser Sync is a desktop-only Obsidian plugin that imports local browser visits into Markdown, CSV, or JSON files.
problem: Users lack a way to automatically capture and organize their browsing history into a structured, searchable format within their knowledge base.
summary: Browser Sync imports local browser history from various desktop browsers into organized Markdown, CSV, or JSON notes within the Obsidian vault.
